authority: Host-only model/engineering content comparison; finite checklists are not perfect gold and no candidate or reviewer outcome is inferred.
scope: Only the two completed fresh source-obligation artifacts, frozen host source checks and registered source packets were inspected. No clean candidate graph or current reader/reviewer artifact was used. This file is never supplied to native stages.

capture_categories.explicit_capture: The fact theme and consequential stated qualification are explicitly addressed across named requirements; no verbatim duplication is required. This is not proof that extraction will satisfy them.
capture_categories.broad_coverage_partial: Core content is addressed, but a particular host qualification is less direct or absent from the requirements. The qualification may still be preserved by readers or general instructions.
capture_categories.absent: No mapped requirement captures the consequential fact theme; does not prove it is absent from sources or later extraction.
capture_categories.invalid_premise: A concrete source-unsupported/conflicting premise was established; scope/detail overprescription is recorded separately rather than falsely calling reported science untrue.

requirements_scope_risks.assessment: The demonstrational floodlight/patterned distinction is consequential. Complete-cleavage observations at apparatus-specific durations are supporting characterization, yet the whole bundle is unconditional required. Their absence from a qualified core graph should not automatically equal a missing physical handoff.

Reported variant-specific QC and expression normalization are source facts. The same unconditional requirement also mandates feature counts, elbow-selected PCs, clustering and UMAP, though these can belong to optional biological analysis beyond measured readout. Evaluate applicability/detail separately.

The required pooling/library-identity/readout handoff is captured, but exact1:9, platform and read-cycle settings are unconditionally required. Frozen hostSOURCE13 intentionally distinguishes these settings from core architecture. Incorrect asserted settings are errors; their absence alone need not be an interface omission.

The source-example read transformation is accurately attributed, but exact offsets/whitelist filtering and reject routes are unconditional required. A supported named decoding boundary can be scientifically useful without reproducing every example-script detail; hostSOURCE15 makes this conditional.

The available identities and role assignments matter, and false-unavailable claims would be errors. Requirements additionally demand every22ADT target/clone/barcode and all50A/50B oligos as retained exact resources. This may overexpand a general-method graph; source-bound retrievable inventories may preserve identity without copying all rows. No scientific falsehood is asserted.

Raw-versus-normalized interpretation and flow-banding limitations matter when expression intensity is interpreted. The Figure2A map normalization status is supporting context, not necessarily mandatory production-route content.

triage_use: If a later consequential fact is missing despite explicit source-stage capture, inspect reader findings, integration dispositions and review decisions before attributing the failure to source-obligation discovery.
If a broad/partial qualification is lost, the source stage is a possible upstream contributor but causation is not established; compare the actual source evidence and intermediate artifacts.
A model can introduce a new unsupported claim even when the correct requirement exists. Requirements presence is not an enforcement or entailment guarantee.

A required bundle may contain both core interfaces and example settings. Host evaluation must record the type/consequence of an omission rather than treating an entire bundle as one binary scientific error.
overall_assessment: All39 frozen host fact themes have requirement matches:37 explicit and2 broad/partial. No wholly absent core theme or confirmed invalid scientific premise was identified in this focused comparison. The major visible harness risk is applicability and detail-level overprescription, not lack of discovered assay themes.
